notes.title: 🛠️ Demo Update: Improved Physics-Based Throwing!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

We've just pushed an update to the Journey Through the Undead demo, and it makes throwing stuff at zombies way more satisfying.

You could always grab and throw items before, but now the system has been refined for smoother physics, better accuracy, and more impactful hits. Whether it's a table, a chair, or whatever else you can grab, it now feels faster, and more fun to use in a fight.

Check out this short clip of me testing it out by hurling objects at some unfortunate undead:
[previewyoutube=q8bZqR0uw6M;full][/previewyoutube]

Give it a try in the updated demo and let us know how it feels!

Thanks for playing,
Dazzling Divine

notes.title: Journey Through the Undead – Demo Out Now!
notes.content:
🎉 The Demo is Now Live! 🎉

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3683650/Journey_Through_the_Undead_Demo/

We’re excited to announce that the Journey Through the Undead demo is officially available to play!

🧟‍♂️ Blast through the first three missions as you fight for survival across a stunning, mutated world filled with relentless zombies.
🔫 Gear up with guns, melee weapons, and grenades to face the dangers lurking in a beautiful yet terrifying world.

This is just the beginning, we're thrilled to share this early slice of the game with you and hear your feedback!

👉 Play the Demo Now and Wishlist the Full Game!
Your feedback and support mean the world to us and help shape the final game.

Thank you so much for being part of this journey. We can’t wait to hear what you think!

Stay safe out there, survivors. 🧟🔥

- Dazzling Divine

notes.title: Performance Improvement Update
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

The game had high CPU usage issues when a large number of zombies present in the game. With this update NPCs are optimized based on the current frame rate. Also, I have added a new Graphic setting called NPC Animation Quality, which controls the level of optimization.

Now the game performs better overall and CPU bottlenecking is minimum. 

Further, optimizations will be introduced soon with the upcoming Unreal Engine 5.3 upgrade.

Thanks!
Dazzling Divine

notes.title: Aftertime - DLSS 3 Update is Here
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

Aftertime - DLSS 3 Update is Here. With this update the game is upgraded to Unreal Engine 5.2 as well. 

Watch the video for performance enhancements with DLSS 3.

Also, I have added highly detailed realistic 3D explosion effects to the asteroid cutscene in the first mission. We will be creating brand new 3D simulated fire and explosion effects for the game soon.

[previewyoutube=ZJpBdlqpB3A;full][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: New Update Details
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

Hope you are doing well. After considering your feedback, I have finally decided to make the game automatically save weapons, ammo and med kits at each checkpoint. So, the player will carry all the items he picked up into the next mission and also when retrying a mission after death. 

However, since this could make the game less challenging, I decided to limit the amount of ammo the player can carry to 200, max number of Med kits and Grenades to 10. Unfortunately, the previous save file is not compatible with the new one and therefore, your progress will be lost.

Further, with this update I have added 3 difficulty levels to the game, which you can change at any point of the champaign. I will experiment on the system further and also get your feedback and keep improving this system.

Finally, I have optimized the waterfall in Mission 9 greatly. Now it runs very smoothly and no CPU bottlenecks happen even at highest settings. I will be adding more of these kind of simulations to the game in the future. 

Thanks!
Dazzling Divine
